Version 9.5.3 of the Elastic Stack was released today. We recommend you[upgrade to this latest version](https://www.elastic.co/docs/deploy-manage/upgrade) . We recommend 9.5.3 over the previous versions 9.5.2


For details of the issues that have been fixed and a full list of changes for each product in this version, please refer to[the release notes](https://www.elastic.co/docs/release-notes) .
